verdict.rationale: The official README and AGENTS.md document an explicit `npx skills update` command. It can update all installed skills, a single skill by name, or several named skills (skills-cli-gh-26, skills-cli-gh-42), described as "Update skills to latest versions" (skills-cli-docs-9, skills-cli-docs-21). Symlinked canonical copies are presented as making updates easy (skills-cli-gh-41). HN commenters said update paths were undocumented (skills-cli-comm-10, skills-cli-comm-11), but they report no hands-on failure, and the current docs show the command, so this lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that `update` works, and documentation of how "latest" is resolved (git ref, version pinning) and how updates interact with skills-lock.json.
